stem.text: The photomicrograph shows plant cells in different stages of the mitotic cell cycle. Four of the cells are labelled with a number to identify them.

stem.alt: Photomicrograph of plant cells in different stages of mitosis, with cells labelled 1 to 4

stem.text: One of the numbered cells is within the main stage of mitosis in which the spindle begins to form.
A second numbered cell is within the main stage of mitosis in which the spindle fibres shorten.
Which row correctly identifies the two cells that are in these stages of mitosis?
